narrative.intro: Salient Crgt has $72.1M in contract obligations for FY2027 to date. Salient Crgt received 7 awards so far, with an average award size of $10.3M, and obligations fell 94.6% year over year. Salient Crgt obligations in FY2027 are concentrated in two agencies: the Department of Homeland Security, which obligated $51.9M, and the General Services Administration, which obligated $19.5M. Salient Crgt work is concentrated in two NAICS markets: Computer Systems Design Services, which accounts for $51.9M, and Engineering Services, which accounts for $19.5M. Historical fiscal-year obligations show a peak in FY26 at $1.3B, with prior totals of $821M in FY25, $562M in FY24, $505M in FY23, and $405M in FY22. Salient Crgt also recorded $733K from the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation in FY2027 and $0 obligations from the Department of the Interior and the Department of Housing and Urban Development so far this fiscal year. The current-year totals are partial and reflect contract obligations rather than total contract values for the largest awards and expiring contracts.
